Strategy: Prefer the roomiest feasible bin so tight bins stay available for later small items, but an exact fit always wins outright. This flips Best Fit ranking whenever the tightest bin is not exact, which may preserve useful small residuals or waste space by leaving many half-filled bins.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (r - item) for r in bins]
```
